title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
why_read: An interesting applied agent project letting Claude Code autonomously reverse-engineer and mod PC games using generative art/3D/audio tools, useful for anyone curious about practical agentic coding workflows.
analysis: This repository packages 'skills' and tool integrations so an AI coding agent can perform game reverse engineering, generate replacement assets via a generative media API, and test the modded game automatically. It's a concrete example of agentic AI being applied to a messy, real-world software task rather than a toy benchmark. The novelty is more in the orchestration and tooling glue than in any new underlying algorithm.
